categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Haier Biomedical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: Life Sciences and Medical Innovation. The Life Sciences segment serves research institutions and pharmaceutical companies with products like automated sample management, biological cultivation, centrifugation, and laboratory consumables. The Medical Innovation segment targets hospitals, public health, blood/plasma stations, and community health centers, offering digital hospital solutions, automated medication management, vaccine cold chain solutions, and blood safety management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-efficiency Stirling refrigeration, carbon-hydrogen deep low-temperature refrigeration, multi-parameter precise control, high-speed centrifugation, polymer surface modification, automation, digitalization, and biotechnology. It has developed six core technology platforms covering refrigeration, intelligent automation, precision manufacturing, digital systems, and biotechnologies. Manufacturing is mainly based on make-to-order with some inventory, supported by multiple production lines and GMP-certified facilities for medical devices and pharmaceuticals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical companies, research universities, hospitals, disease control centers, blood/plasma stations, and public health institutions. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with notable clients such as Shanghai Ruijin Hospital, WuXi AppTec, Fudan University, China CDC, and major pharmaceutical firms. It also collaborates with international organizations like WHO and UNICEF, serving over 150 countries and regions globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic coverage across over 200 cities and regions. It has a growing international presence with over 800 overseas distributors covering more than 150 countries, including established local operations in the UK, UAE, Nigeria, Singapore, the Netherlands, and the USA. The company has established user experience centers and logistics hubs in key global markets to support localized service and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haier Biomedical operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It engages in research and development, manufacturing, and direct sales of biomedical equipment and digital solutions. The company manages procurement of raw materials and components, production, and distribution, including after-sales services, positioning itself as an integrated biomedical equipment and solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with increased R&D investment (14.06% of revenue in 2023). It focuses on expanding core technology platforms in refrigeration, automation, digitalization, and biotechnology. Strategic R&D initiatives include developing automated cell preparation, intelligent sample management, vaccine cold chain automation, and digital health platforms. The company pursues an open innovation model involving user participation and collaborates with academic and industry partners to accelerate product commercialization and ecosystem development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of medical and laboratory equipment, digital solutions, and related consumables. The company also earns income from installation services, software maintenance, and equipment leasing. Sales are conducted mainly through a distributor network complemented by direct sales to key institutional customers and international organizations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haier Biomedical is a leading player in China's biomedical low-temperature storage and medical equipment industry, ranked first domestically and among the top three globally in its segment. It has broken foreign monopolies in low-temperature biomedical technology and holds a strong position with extensive patents and certifications. The company competes by integrating digital and automation technologies to offer comprehensive smart solutions, differentiating itself through innovation and global market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.28 billion, a 20.36% decrease from 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 406 million, down 32.41%. Despite short-term revenue decline due to macroeconomic and industry challenges, core business revenues excluding public health-related sales showed slight growth. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets of RMB 5.53 billion and net assets of RMB 4.23 billion, investing heavily in R&D and global expansion to sustain long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haier Biomedical emphasizes delivering best-in-class user experience through integrated 'soft-hardware-service' digital scene solutions tailored to diverse biomedical and medical innovation scenarios. Its competitive differentiation lies in proprietary advanced refrigeration technologies, automation, digitalization, and biotechnology platforms, enabling high efficiency, traceability, and compliance. The company’s global localized service network and collaboration with international organizations further enhance its value proposition as a trusted, innovative partner in life sciences and healthcare.
